The structure of composition Rb2K2Pb2Br10 (reduced formula RbKPbBr5) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 143), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies K and Pb centers each in octahedral environments coordinated by six Br neighbors, while Rb centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 Br neighbors. These polyhedra connect into a three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include edge-sharing between K and Pb octahedra and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Rb and K or Pb polyhedra.
